title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: HOLDING TANK STEEL BRACKET LOCATION (306 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CLASS B MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON THE SPRINTER CHASSIS, THE STEEL BRACKET SECURING THE HOLDING TANK IS INSTALLED IN A LOCATION IN WHICH IT PRESSES AGAINST THE OEM BRAKE LINES.

title: Haulmark Industries, Inc.: REAR SPRING HANGER BRACKETS (147 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES, THE REAR SPRING HANGER BRACKETS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN ACCORDANCE WITH HAULMARK'S SPECIFICATIONS DURING THE MODIFICATION PROCESS.  THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE THE SPRING HANGER FASTENERS TO LOSE TORQUE AND FAIL.

title: International Motors, LLC: DRIVER'S SEAT BELT TETHERS (125 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY TRUCK/TRACTORS EQUIPPED WITH SEARS ATLAS SERIES 35, 70, OR 80 DRIVER'S SEATS, WHEN THE SEATS ARE IN THEIR LOWEST, MOST REARWARD ADJUSTED POSITION, THEY MAY CHAFE THE SEAT BELT TETHER THAT CONNECTS FROM THE SEAT TO THE BACK OF THE CAB.

title: International Motors, LLC: REAR DRIVE AXLE SPINDLE/ARVINMERITOR (4 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY TRUCK/TRACTORS EQUIPPED WITH ARVINMERITOR SERIES 145 AND 160 REAR DRIVE AXLES.  THE SUSPECT REAR DRIVE AXLE'S SPINDLES MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY HEAT TREATED.  SUCH A CONDITION LESSENS THE OVERALL STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY OF THE SPINDLES AND COULD RESULT IN ITS FRACTURE.

title: Hyundai Motor America: OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (12,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN  OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (OCS) THE RIGHT FRONT SEAT OF THE VEHICLE MAY MISCLASSIFY CERTAIN SMALL CHILDREN SEATED ON THE FRONT EDGE OF THE SEAT AS AN ADULT.

title: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.: IDLER SHAFT BOLT (1,848 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS, THE CYLINDER HEAD IDLER GEAR SHAFT BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED DURING INITIAL ASSEMBLY.  CONTINUED OPERATION IN THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE THE BOLT TO LOOSEN, RESULTING IN ABNORMAL NOISE FROM IMPROPER GEAR ALIGNMENT.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: REAR DRIVE AXLE SPINDLES/ARVIN-MERITOR (2 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH ARVINMERITOR SERIES 145 AND 160 REAR DRIVE AXLES.  SOME OF THE SPINDLES WERE OVERHEATED DURING THE HEAT TREAT PROCESS WHICH COULD RESULT IN A FRACTURE OF THE SPINDLE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: REAR DRIVE AXLE SPINDLES/ARVIN-MERITOR (7 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH ARVINMERITOR SERIES 145 AND 160 REAR DRIVE AXLES.  SOME OF THE SPINDLES WERE OVERHEATED DURING THE HEAT TREAT PROCESS WHICH COULD RESULT IN A FRACTURE OF THE SPINDLE.

title: J&L CARGO EXPRESS: RIM/TREDIT (21 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN ENCLOSED CARGO TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH TREDIT WHEELS, THE RIMS MAY HAVE POOR WELD QUALITY AND INSUFFICIENT PRESS FIT BETWEEN THE WHEEL RIM AND DISC.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: FRONT BRAKE ROTOR (801 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 16-INCH WHEELS, THE FRONT BRAKE DISCS MAY BREAK UNDER SEVERE DRIVING CONDITIONS. summary: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat and melt or char the plastic case, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 135,000 battery packs worldwide, including about 85,000 in the U.S..

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The drive pulley inner flange could break, resulting in the broken flange fragments becoming projectiles. This situation could cause serious injuries or death to the rider or bystanders. Units: About 275.

summary: The unit's control board can ignite and, in certain units, can result in the ignition of flammable material adjacent to the unit. Units: About 28,700.
